verdict.rationale: Poly documents an official sync service: files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer and sync back automatically, the product runs on web and desktop, and an offline queue syncs changes when you reconnect. Nothing in the evidence mentions encryption of any kind, let alone end-to-end encryption the vendor cannot read. That is a core half of the story. missing for 10: end-to-end/zero-knowledge encryption documentation, explicit multi-device (including mobile) sync coverage, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, an official sync service keeps my notes updated across all my devices with end-to-end encryption the vendor can't read

citations.quote: your Poly files appear as a real folder in Finder or Explorer, with files downloading on demand and syncing back automatically.
The queue survives restarts, so work done on a plane syncs itself when you land
